_comment: What flutter-vita builds against, and its own release. Read by the CLI (precache, doctor, --version) and the build scripts; edited by hand when a release moves.

flutter_sdk._comment: Google's release archives of the pinned Flutter, by host. tools/flutter-sdk.sh downloads one, checks the sha256 and unpacks it to ~/.flutter-vita/flutter/<flutter>. Hashes from releases_<os>.json under base_url.

engine._comment: No engine release for this Flutter yet: release, url and sha256 are empty until /ps-vita-publish fills them. Build the engine and package it into out/artifacts/ (docs/engine.md).
